text:
zoe: LumenPay legal asked for perf numbers to finalize the deal. Scope: streaming chat (1k ctx) + embeddings ingest. They need p95 token-stream <= 320ms, sustained 70 qps, short 3m spikes to 280 qps. embeddings ~900/min, 768-d. Can eng/ops propose a compact runbook + committed vs burst cost sketch?
alex: quick Qs: model target = 13B quant? want FP16 fallback?
zoe: yes 13B quant preferred. FP16 optional if SLA not met. fallback to 7B acceptable.
morgan: runbook proposal (compact): smoke, warmup, sustained, burst, cold-start. use anonymized sample prompts (avg prompt 130 tokens, gen 230). Include KV cache warmup and cache-eviction test.
morgan: runbook:
```
phase 1: smoke 3m @ 2 qps (auth + payload)
phase 2: warmup 15m ramp to 40 qps (populate caches)
phase 3: sustain hold 70 qps for 30m collect p50/p95/p99, tokens/s
phase 4: bursts 3 cycles 3m @ 280 qps with 4m cooldowns
phase 5: cold-start test: kill one pod & issue 12 concurrent streams
metrics: p50/p95/p99 token latency, tokens/sec, gpu_util, queue_depth, 5xx%
```
ops-bot: provision: dedicated/poc-lumenpay -> queued at 2025-01-10T09:12:00Z
alex: infra sketch: sustained 70 qps ~ 3 A100-eq GPUs (round up to 3 committed). bursts to 280 qps via 3 pre-warmed on-demand GPUs. Recommend commit 3 units, burst pool 3.
zoe: rough cost ballpark for procurement?
alex: back-of-envelope: commit 3 units -> ~$72k/month. burst burn ~ $130/hr per GPU * 3 => $390/hr during spikes. refine after profiling.
security-amy: security checklist: customer-managed KMS, VPC peering, audit logs, signed DPA. For POC we can use temp key and provide logs snapshot. Need their security contact.
customer-luca: sharing security lead now (luca@lumenpay.com). we'll send questionnaire in 90m. please include failure-mode playbook for our SRE review.
morgan: failure modes to include: cold-start tail spikes, KV-cache miss storms, network fan-in causing queueing. Mitigations: staged warmup, prefix caching, pre-warm nodes, rate-shaping, graceful fallback to 7B.
zoe: timeline ask: run smoke+warmup tomorrow 09:00 PT, deliver CSV + 1-paragraph exec summary within 36h. Owners: morgan (loadgen + payloads), alex (infra & cost), security-amy (security steps), luca (questionnaire). I'll collate and attach to deal. :thumbsup:
customer-luca: questionnaire sent. thanks team.
zoe: thanks all 1 keep updates in-thread.
